KPI re-baselining: 100,000 members vs 78,608 sector total; AUM ~1.5x whole sector. Held with the KPI decision.

verify-docs.sh prose blind spot (04:829, 04:1087) + no context exclusion on n_snake_name.
'etsgiin ner' vs 'etsgiin_ner' spacing — decide canonical spelling.

Currency residual (after the 20260724 apply, usd re-baselined to 131): re-denominate the remaining HELD sets once their gating decision lands — KPI cluster (needs KPI re-baselining), program-config caps DEC-65/63 (needs program budget), $88.20+$40 installment (needs rate model), 06 ledger amounts (needs controller ledger rewrite), persona incomes (income-basis task). Minor-unit TERM cleanup: 'cents' still used as the minor-unit name (04:9 gloss, 04:657 *_cents config keys, schema field names). MNT minor unit is möngö (obsolete); the whole-tögrög convention means these should be reconciled in one terminology pass (rename/neutralize 'cents' -> 'minor units').

Currency migration completeness: sweep for BARE minor-units money literals (amount:/par_value:/N cents with no $) missed by the $-anchored inventory — 3 found & fixed in 04 this run; audit 06 and any schema examples for the same pattern.
